text.0: A still life composition on a rustic, light brown wooden surface. A deep red ceramic mug, filled with a light brown beverage, sits on the left, next to a white card with "OPEN LATE" handwritten in black. To its right, a bright yellow hardcover book, labeled "EVENING READS" on its spine, lies flat. Centered on the book is a light blue rubber duck with a darker blue beak and black eyes. Further right, a small green cactus in a white ceramic pot with light brown pebbles rests on the wooden surface. The background features a blurry window frame with bright light filtering through, suggesting an indoor setting.

text.4: On a weathered wooden desk sits a steaming red coffee mug beside a small hand-lettered sign bearing a crescent moon. Beyond it lies an open notebook, its pages washed in soft yellow, where a cheerful yellow rubber duck perches next to a blue one. Along the back edge, a windowsill holds a tiny potted cactus, a leafy houseplant in a terracotta pot, and a smooth grey stone. Through the window, warm morning sunlight pours in, bathing everything in golden light, the scene calm, cozy, and quietly content.
text.6: This 2D, cartoon-style illustration depicts a light brown room with a large, four-pane window in the upper center, showcasing a bright yellow sky outside. Below the window is a wooden sill holding two potted green plants (a cactus and a leafy plant) and a gray stone. A beam of light shines from the top-right window pane downwards to the center. On a dark brown surface in the foreground, from left to right, are a steaming red mug, a small white easel with a yellow crescent moon painting, and an open yellow notebook with a yellow rubber duck on the left page and a blue rubber duck on the right page. The room's wall is a solid light brown.
text.8: This ASCII art image, rendered in monochromatic green on a dark background, depicts an indoor scene with several objects. In the upper section, a window-like structure with small dots suggesting rain against it is present. On a shelf below the window, a potted cactus, a small plant, and a car-like object are arranged left to right. Raindrops are indicated below the shelf. In the lower section, a steaming mug is on the left. To its right, an easel holds a canvas with a face-like drawing. Further right, two framed boxes labeled "(yellow)" and "(blue)" each contain a different ASCII art face. The entire bottom is bordered by a thick, patterned line of hash symbols.
text.10: This minimalist, dark-green monochromatic scene depicts a room with a window at the top, showing vertical white lines representing rain against a darker green sky. Below the window, on a narrow shelf, sits a potted cactus, a paper boat, and a toy car. Directly under the shelf, a larger, light-green square figure with two small square eyes and a horizontal line mouth stands on four thin legs, resembling a table or chair. To its right, two similar but darker green square figures, also with eyes and mouths, sit on the floor. On the far left, a green mug emits five semi-transparent, octagonal puffs of steam. The floor and walls are a solid, deep green.

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><style>html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#020802}</style></head>
<body><script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
const W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
const r=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});r.setSize(W,H);document.body.appendChild(r.domElement);
const s=new THREE.Scene();s.background=new THREE.Color(0x020a03);s.fog=new THREE.Fog(0x020a03,14,30);
const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,W/H,0.1,100);cam.position.set(0,3.2,13);cam.lookAt(0,2.6,0);
s.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0x2a6a30,1.2));
const pl=new THREE.PointLight(0x66ff77,40,20);pl.position.set(0,6,5);s.add(pl);
const d=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0x99ffaa,0.8);d.position.set(-3,8,6);s.add(d);
const M=c=>new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color:c,flatShading:true});
const g=M(0x2f9a3e),dg=M(0x114a1a),lg=M(0x7dff8a),em=new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x8cff9a});
function box(w,h,dd,m,x,y,z,p=s){const o=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,dd),m);o.position.set(x,y,z);p.add(o);return o}
function cyl(a,b,h,m,x,y,z,n=7){const o=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(a,b,h,n),m);o.position.set(x,y,z);s.add(o);return o}
// wall & floor
box(20,12,0.2,M(0x0a2a10),0,5,-2);box(20,0.2,8,M(0x0c3312),0,-0.1,1);
// window
box(6,3,0.1,M(0x031a08),0,6.5,-1.85);
[[0,8.05,6.2,.15],[0,4.95,6.2,.15]].forEach(a=>box(a[2],a[3],.2,g,a[0],a[1],-1.8));
[-3,0,3].forEach(x=>box(.15,3.2,.2,g,x,6.5,-1.8));
const drops=[];for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const o=box(.03,.18,.03,em,(Math.random()-.5)*5.8,5+Math.random()*3,-1.7);drops.push(o)}
// shelf
box(7,.2,1,g,0,4.4,-1.4);
cyl(.35,.25,.5,dg,-2.2,4.75,-1.4);cyl(.18,.2,.9,lg,-2.2,5.4,-1.4);cyl(.08,.08,.4,lg,-1.95,5.5,-1.4).rotation.z=-.8;
cyl(.3,.22,.4,dg,0,4.7,-1.4);for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const l=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(.12,.6,4),lg);l.position.set(Math.cos(i*1.3)*.15,5.1,-1.4+Math.sin(i*1.3)*.15);l.rotation.z=Math.cos(i*1.3)*.5;s.add(l)}
box(1,.3,.5,g,2.2,4.65,-1.4);box(.6,.25,.45,lg,2.15,4.9,-1.4);[[1.85,-1.15],[2.55,-1.15],[1.85,-1.65],[2.55,-1.65]].forEach(p=>cyl(.12,.12,.08,dg,p[0],4.55,p[1],8).rotation.x=Math.PI/2);
// drops below shelf
for(let i=0;i<14;i++)drops.push(box(.04,.2,.04,em,(Math.random()-.5)*6,2.8+Math.random()*1.4,-1.3));
// mug
cyl(.45,.4,.9,g,-5,.45,1,10);const h=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(.25,.07,5,8),g);h.position.set(-5.5,.5,1);s.add(h);
const steam=[];for(let i=0;i<6;i++){const o=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(.12,5,4),new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color:0x8cff9a,transparent:true,opacity:.5}));s.add(o);steam.push(o)}
// easel
[[-.6,.2],[.6,-.2]].forEach(a=>{const l=box(.1,4,.1,dg,-1.5+a[0],1.8,.5);l.rotation.z=a[1]});box(.1,3.6,.1,dg,-1.5,1.7,0).rotation.x=-.25;
box(1.8,.1,.3,dg,-1.5,1.3,.6);
function face(x,y,z,w,hh,bg){box(w,hh,.08,bg,x,y,z);box(.15,.15,.05,em,x-w*.2,y+hh*.1,z+.06);box(.15,.15,.05,em,x+w*.2,y+hh*.1,z+.06);box(w*.4,.08,.05,em,x,y-hh*.2,z+.06)}
face(-1.5,2.3,.62,1.6,1.8,M(0x1d5a25));
// framed faces
[[2.2,0x3a7a20],[4.4,0x0f4a3a]].forEach(a=>{box(1.8,2.1,.15,g,a[0],1.5,.4);face(a[0],1.5,.5,1.5,1.8,M(a[1]))});
// hash border
for(let i=0;i<40;i++){box(.5,.08,.1,lg,-10+i*.5,-.05,4.6+(i%2)*.15);box(.08,.08,.5,lg,-10+i*.5,-.05,4.7)}
let t=0;function loop(){t+=.016;drops.forEach(o=>{o.position.y-=.05;if(o.position.y<(o.position.z<-1.5?5:2.8))o.position.y+=o.position.z<-1.5?3:1.6});
steam.forEach((o,i)=>{const k=(t*.4+i/6)%1;o.position.set(-5+Math.sin(k*6+i)*.15,1+k*1.6,1);o.scale.setScalar(1+k*2);o.material.opacity=.5*(1-k)});
r.render(s,cam);requestAnimationFrame(loop)}
loop();window.__ready=true;
</script></body></html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head><style>html,body{margin:0;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#0b2a1a}</style></head>
<body><script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
const W=innerWidth,H=innerHeight;
const r=new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias:true});r.setSize(W,H);document.body.appendChild(r.domElement);
const s=new THREE.Scene();s.background=new THREE.Color(0x0b2a1a);
const cam=new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(45,W/H,0.1,100);
s.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xcfffd8,0x0a2010,1.2));
const dl=new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff,1.2);dl.position.set(3,6,5);s.add(dl);
const M=c=>new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:c,flatShading:true});
function box(w,h,d,c,x,y,z,p=s){const m=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w,h,d),M(c));m.position.set(x,y,z);p.add(m);return m;}
// room
box(12,0.2,8,0x114a2c,0,-0.1,0);
box(12,8,0.2,0x0f3d24,0,4,-4);
box(0.2,8,8,0x0d3520,-6,4,0);
// window
box(4.4,2.6,0.1,0x1f6b42,0,5.6,-3.88);
box(4,2.2,0.12,0x062012,0,5.6,-3.85);
const rain=[];
for(let i=0;i<22;i++){const l=box(0.03,0.4,0.02,0xffffff,-1.9+Math.random()*3.8,5.6,-3.78);l.userData.o=Math.random()*2.2;rain.push(l);}
// shelf
box(5,0.15,0.9,0x2a8a55,0,3.6,-3.4);
// cactus
box(0.5,0.4,0.5,0x3a9a60,-1.6,3.88,-3.4);
const cac=new THREE.Group();cac.position.set(-1.6,4.08,-3.4);s.add(cac);
box(0.22,0.7,0.22,0x5fd08a,0,0.35,0,cac);box(0.12,0.3,0.12,0x5fd08a,0.17,0.45,0,cac);box(0.12,0.3,0.12,0x5fd08a,-0.17,0.3,0,cac);
// paper boat
const boat=new THREE.Group();boat.position.set(0,3.8,-3.4);s.add(boat);
const hull=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.4,0.2,0.2,4),M(0xd8ffe4));hull.rotation.y=Math.PI/4;hull.scale.z=0.4;boat.add(hull);
const sail=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.2,0.4,3),M(0xd8ffe4));sail.position.y=0.28;boat.add(sail);
// car
const car=new THREE.Group();car.position.set(1.6,3.78,-3.4);s.add(car);
box(0.7,0.2,0.35,0x4ec07c,0,0.05,0,car);box(0.35,0.18,0.3,0x6fe09a,-0.05,0.24,0,car);
for(const x of[-0.22,0.22])for(const z of[-0.18,0.18]){const w=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.09,0.09,0.06,8),M(0x083018));w.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;w.position.set(x,-0.07,z);car.add(w);}
// creatures
function creature(sz,c,x,z,legs){const g=new THREE.Group();g.position.set(x,0,z);s.add(g);
 const by=legs?1.2:sz/2;const b=box(sz,sz,sz*0.8,c,0,by,0,g);
 box(sz*0.14,sz*0.14,0.05,0x06190e,-sz*0.2,sz*0.15,sz*0.4,b);box(sz*0.14,sz*0.14,0.05,0x06190e,sz*0.2,sz*0.15,sz*0.4,b);
 box(sz*0.4,0.05,0.05,0x06190e,0,-sz*0.2,sz*0.4,b);
 if(legs)for(const lx of[-1,1])for(const lz of[-1,1])box(0.08,1.2-sz/2,0.08,c,lx*sz*0.4,(1.2-sz/2)/2,lz*sz*0.3,g);
 return {g,b,by};}
const big=creature(1.4,0x8ee8a8,0,-2.4,true);
const c1=creature(0.8,0x2f7d4c,2.2,-1.8,false);
const c2=creature(0.7,0x286a40,3.3,-1.4,false);
// mug
const mug=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.35,0.3,0.7,8),M(0x3fae6a));mug.position.set(-4.5,0.35,-1.5);s.add(mug);
const hd=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.18,0.05,4,8),M(0x3fae6a));hd.position.set(-4.12,0.38,-1.5);s.add(hd);
const puffs=[];
for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const p=new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2,0.2,0.05,8),new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color:0xcfffe0,transparent:true,opacity:0.5,flatShading:true}));p.rotation.x=Math.PI/2;s.add(p);puffs.push(p);}
const clk=new THREE.Clock();
function f(){const t=clk.getElapsedTime();
 rain.forEach(l=>{l.position.y=6.5-((t*2.5+l.userData.o)%2.2);});
 cac.rotation.z=Math.sin(t*1.5)*0.05;boat.rotation.z=Math.sin(t*2)*0.12;car.position.x=1.6+Math.sin(t*1.2)*0.3;
 big.b.position.y=big.by+Math.sin(t*2)*0.05;big.g.rotation.y=Math.sin(t*0.8)*0.15;
 c1.b.position.y=c1.by+Math.abs(Math.sin(t*3))*0.2;c2.b.position.y=c2.by+Math.abs(Math.sin(t*3+1.5))*0.2;c2.b.rotation.z=Math.sin(t*2)*0.1;
 puffs.forEach((p,i)=>{const k=(t*0.4+i/5)%1;p.position.set(-4.5+Math.sin(k*6+i)*0.2,0.9+k*2.2,-1.5);p.scale.setScalar(0.6+k*1.2);p.material.opacity=0.6*(1-k);p.rotation.z=k*2;});
 const a=Math.sin(t*0.25)*0.6;cam.position.set(Math.sin(a)*11,4.2,Math.cos(a)*11);cam.lookAt(-0.3,2.4,-2);
 r.render(s,cam);window.__ready=true;requestAnimationFrame(f);}
f();
addEventListener('resize',()=>{cam.aspect=innerWidth/innerHeight;cam.updateProjectionMatrix();r.setSize(innerWidth,innerHeight);});
</script></body></html>
